name: product-squad
description: Product management & discovery: triages Notion product ideas into researched PRDs (build/reject verdicts) and harvests daily user feedback from your configured sources into a Notion feedback DB.
author: pancake-official

workflows.summary: Sweep the Notion ideas DB for Status=New entries; research each (feasibility, market, competition), decide build vs reject, write a full PRD sub-page, and update the entry's status and notes.
workflows.outcome: Every Status=New idea is moved to Todo or Rejected with a complete PRD filed as a Notion sub-page and a verdict note on the entry; a per-run digest lands on the board.

workflows.summary: Write a full, research-backed PRD for a named product idea (ad hoc — the idea doesn't need to exist in the ideas DB yet).

idea.description: The product idea to write the PRD for, in one or two sentences. The agent files the PRD against the matching ideas-DB entry, creating one if none exists.
idea.example: Let users export any board view to CSV

context.description: Optional extra context the cofounder has — who asked, constraints, prior discussion, links.
context.example: Requested by two design partners this week; must work without a paid plan

workflows.outcome: A complete PRD (problem, solution, scope, user stories, technical approach, steps, open questions, success metrics, research sources) filed as a Notion sub-page, with a build/reject verdict summarized on the board.

workflows.summary: Run the daily feedback harvest: read the configured sources from MEMORY, collect everything new since the last run, dedupe, file into the Notion feedback DB, and flag recurring themes.
workflows.outcome: All new feedback since the last checkpoint is deduplicated and filed in the Notion feedback DB with priority labels; recurring themes and any P0s are flagged in the run digest; the checkpoint is advanced.

required_vault_secrets.label: Notion internal integration token (Settings → Connections → Develop or manage integrations). Used for raw Notion API database queries that the built-in Notion tool doesn't cover. Share both the ideas DB and the feedback DB with the integration.
